findings.title: Path Traversal Arbitrary File Read
findings.description: File paths are constructed using user-supplied parameters without canonicalization, permitting an attacker to escape the target directory using dot-dot-slash (../) sequences.
remediation_steps: Sanitize user input with os.path.basename or secure_filename before constructing file paths.
Verify that the canonicalized path (os.path.realpath) starts with the intended base directory.
Enforce a strict whitelist of permitted filenames or IDs.
